name: Mary Crow
source:
A 14 year old born in England. Maria is her Baptismal name. She is an exorcist that fights against heretics despite being possessed by a demon herself.

She is a cursed girl who is said to die if the curse is not lifted by All Saints Day when she is 14... she is rumored to be possessed by the demon Uriel.

Received a gifted education at the Vatican and was recognized as an exorcist under the direct control of the Vatican. This time, she will be dispatched to Japan under the order of the Holy See.

[Translated from [url=http://maria.karin-e.jp/dc/02_chara/01.htm]official website[/url]]
